vision.edits.keys: 1 to 9 give the selection a label (in the order of Label as), 0 its label from the import; P pins it.
vision.edits.relabelledPending: Saving runs the quality rules again: they read the labels and thresholds.
vision.thresholds.title: Thresholds
vision.thresholds.help: The measures are already in the table: changing a threshold only runs the R-VQ rules again, no image is read. Preview shows what they would say; nothing is written until you save a version.
vision.thresholds.invalid: Every threshold is a positive number.
vision.thresholds.compare: Images found by each rule, now and with these thresholds
vision.model.targetHint: A numeric column of the labels file, with 20 known values and 10 distinct ones at least (R-VML-05).
vision.target.tip.r2: Share of the target's variance the model explains, on images it did not learn from: 1 is perfect, 0 is no better than the mean, below 0 worse.
vision.target.tip.mae: Average distance between the predicted and the true value, in the column's own unit.
vision.target.tip.rmse: Like the mean absolute error, but large errors weigh more.
vision.target.tip.median: Half the images are predicted closer than this.
vision.target.tip.spearman: Does the model rank the images in the right order? 1: same order as the truth.
vision.target.tip.baseline: Predicting the training mean for every image: a model must do better.
vision.target.tip.macroF1: F1 of each label, averaged: a rare label counts as much as a common one.
vision.target.tip.microF1: F1 over every image and label together: common labels weigh more.
vision.target.tip.exact: Share of images whose whole set of labels is right.
vision.target.tip.hamming: Share of image-label pairs that are wrong: 0 is perfect.
vision.target.predictedSentence: R² {r2} on {n} images the model did not learn from; {gain} less error than the training mean.
vision.target.overSentence: The largest errors above the truth: what do these images share?
vision.target.underSentence: The largest errors under the truth.
vision.target.label: Label
vision.target.thresholdNote: An image gets a label when its probability is {threshold} or more (R-VMLB-01).
vision.target.mostWrongSentence: The images whose predicted labels differ most from theirs.
vision.map.moreHint: Two maps from interpretable machine learning (Rudin's lab for PaCMAP) that keep both the neighbours and the layout of the groups. Computed on the points drawn, only when you click; they need the optional extra interpret (R-VMAP-12).
